data.description:
## Description

**What**: Integration-level fixture that drives one synthetic epic through all four touchpoints in sequence: (a) Phase E with non-empty red-team findings → story-decomposer re-dispatch; (b) impl-plan Step 4 with task-decomposer findings → task-decomposer re-dispatch; (c) sprint Phase F Step 18 with verifier P1 != PASS → planner + decomposer dispatch; (d) cycle-MAX failure at the sprint touchpoint → REPLAN_ESCALATE with planner-supplied upstream.

**Why**: SC3 and SC4 are cascade-mapping SCs whose correctness depends on producer-to-consumer continuity (planner output → sprint touchpoint → REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream). Per-story unit fixtures prove each touchpoint in isolation but no story exercises the cascade interaction. Risk register items #5 (drift risk across 4 touchpoints) and #7 (planner-BEFORE-ticket invariant) are end-to-end concerns no unit fixture can verify.

**Scope**:
- IN: Integration fixture file under tests/ that exercises the full cascade
- IN: Assertions on cycle declaration format, cycles[] schema, cascade-mapping matrix, no-placeholder-ticket invariant
- OUT: Individual touchpoint unit fixtures (delivered by SC1-SC5 stories — depended on)

## Done Definitions

- Integration fixture drives the synthetic epic through Phase E → impl-plan Step 4 → sprint Phase F Step 18 → cycle-MAX failure in sequence within one run
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Fixture asserts every touchpoint emits cycle declarations in the exact format defined by the SC4 shared-protocol doc
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Fixture asserts cycles[] entries in each touchpoint's review artifact contain the full SC5 schema {n, draft_hash, findings_count, verdict, timestamp_iso}
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Fixture asserts the cascade mapping observed end-to-end matches the SC4 matrix: Phase E → upstream=brainstorm; impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 → upstream=preplanning; sprint verifier-fail → upstream resolved dynamically from planner's escalation_upstream field (not hardcoded)
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Fixture asserts no placeholder/draft ticket is created at any verifier-fail dispatch site between verifier-result and planner-result reads (SC3 invariant validated end-to-end)
  ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Risk] This is an integration fixture; isolation between touchpoints must be preserved (one synthetic epic drives all four, no cross-talk via shared state).
- [Reliability] The fixture must mock external dispatch boundaries (Task tool, Read tool) but exercise the orchestrator's real dispatch-payload construction at each touchpoint.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator validating the full remediation cascade, I want an end-to-end fixture exercising Phase E -> impl-plan -> sprint verifier-fail in sequence
